title: Arturia AudioFuse USB Audio Interface | Reverb Demo Video
description:
Arturia is a constant source of innovation in the world of electronic music and the new AudioFuse USB Interface is no different. Small enough to fit in a backpack, the AudioFuse includes a host of features, inputs and outputs. Perfect for the bedroom, the studio or the hotel room; the AudioFuse is a compact one-stop-shop for recording solutions.

Read more about the Arturia AudioFuse at: https://goo.gl/iI3vg9
author: Reverb
